description: Off-tick advisory classifier for filtered Unity UAT evidence rows. Never overrides human PASS/FAIL.

thresholds.choice_note: Choice confidence below 0.5 means human review; do not auto-tag.
thresholds.noul_note: Noul has no separate confidence field — the probability is the uncertainty. Do not apply the Choice floor to Noul.
thresholds.score_note: Use Score for rank/threshold only; do not treat interpolated score as a linear severity multiplier.

failure_class.instructions: Given the filtered UAT evidence rows (id, pass/fail, one-line observation, policy id), what is the primary failure class for the failing or uncertain rows? Prefer `none` when all rows pass for expected reasons (including expected empty content).

criteria.presentation: C2 chrome / UI Toolkit host / layout / typography / feedback display defect.
criteria.scenario-content: Policy or scenario content is missing or expected empty (e.g. no mission timeline on this policy).
criteria.sim-code: Simulation, ROE, engagement, or classify FSM behavior looks wrong.
criteria.harness: Unity MCP, Play Mode harness, evidence capture, or test setup defect.
criteria.none: No defect; rows pass or failures are expected content.
criteria.other: Does not fit the closed set above.

severity.instructions: How severe is the primary issue across this evidence packet for the current UAT slice?
criteria: cosmetic — readable but ugly or minor polish; slice still usable
blocks this row — one acceptance row cannot pass; other rows may still proceed
blocks the slice — C2 or Baltic play-through cannot be signed off until fixed

needs_code_change.instructions: Does this evidence indicate a product code change is required (presentation host or other in-repo code), as opposed to expected scenario content or harness-only issues?

criteria.true: A host or product code change is needed to turn a failed acceptance row into a pass.
criteria.false: No code change; expected content, harness-only, or all rows already pass.
